_comment: Curated supplemental identity fields for TAB members that are NOT present in cncf/tab's gov.yaml (linkedin/twitter handles, or a github handle when gov.yaml omits one). Matched by github handle when available, otherwise by exact name. `company` is included only to detect drift versus gov.yaml (a mismatch is logged, gov.yaml always wins) — it is never used to override the authoritative value.
